name: t10-cap02
title: T10 · Cap. 2 · Ajustando as etapas (narração 67,7 s; marcas L1..L5 = início de cada linha do roteiro)

setup.js: (()=>{window.__avisos=[];const re=/N[ãa]o foi poss[ií]vel|erro|Tente novamente|indispon[ií]vel/i;const chk=(t)=>{t=(t||'').trim();const m=t&&t.match(new RegExp('[^]{0,40}('+re.source+')[^]{0,40}','i'));if(m&&window.__avisos.length<10)window.__avisos.push(m[0].replace(/[\n\r\t ]+/g,' '))};new MutationObserver(ms=>{for(const m of ms){m.addedNodes.forEach(n=>chk(n.textContent));if(m.type==='characterData')chk(m.target.textContent)}}).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});chk(document.body.innerText);setInterval(()=>{const f=document.querySelector('section[aria-label^="Lembrete da trilha"]');const e=[...document.querySelectorAll('div.fixed')].some(x=>getComputedStyle(x).backgroundColor==='rgb(17, 17, 17)');if((f||e)&&window.__avisos.length<10&&!window.__avisos.includes('TRILHA DOMIFLIX'))window.__avisos.push('TRILHA DOMIFLIX')},300);return 1})()

cursor sobre a linha de Proposta

steps.js: (async()=>{const S="Visita t\u00e9cnica",D="Proposta";const rows=()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog] [draggable=true]')];const f=t=>rows().find(r=>r.innerText.includes(t));const w=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const dt=new DataTransfer();const ev=(t,el,xy)=>el.dispatchEvent(new DragEvent(t,Object.assign({bubbles:true,cancelable:true,dataTransfer:dt},xy||{})));if(!f(S)||!f(D))return 'sem linha';const nomes=()=>rows().slice(1).map(r=>r.innerText.trim().split('\n')[0]);ev('dragstart',f(S));await w(150);for(let k=0;k<6;k++){const b=f(D),r=b.getBoundingClientRect();const xy={clientX:r.x+30+k*8,clientY:r.y+r.height/2};if(k===0)ev('dragenter',b,xy);ev('dragover',b,xy);await w(90)}ev('drop',f(D),{clientX:f(D).getBoundingClientRect().x+60,clientY:f(D).getBoundingClientRect().y+10});await w(150);const o=f(S);if(o)ev('dragend',o);await w(500);return nomes().join(' > ')})()
steps.label: solta: a Visita técnica fica logo depois do Lead

steps.js: (async()=>{let o='';for(let i=0;i<20;i++){o=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog] [draggable=true]')].slice(1).map(r=>r.innerText.trim().split('\n')[0]).join(' > ');if(o.startsWith('Lead > Visita técnica > Proposta'))break;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300))}return (o.startsWith('Lead > Visita técnica > Proposta')?'OK: ':'DIFERENTE: ')+o})()
